title: gotit Spec (v1)
description: Schema for one E2E test scenario consumed by the gotit runner.

spec_version.description: Major version of the gotit spec format. v1 is the only currently published major.

name.description: Stable identifier; appears in subtest names, JSONL logs, and TUIs.

requires.description: Runtime prerequisites or feature flags. 'feature:<name>' is gated by the features file; 'git' is built in; anything else must be registered via Config.RequirementCheckers.

order.description: Sort position within a wave. Lower comes first; unset (0) sorts after ordered specs alphabetically.

notes_file.description: Override the default sidecar notes path (default: <basename>.md).

fixture.description: Name of a directory under FixturesDir.

helper.description: Name of a programmatic builder registered in Config.RepoHelpers.

daemons.description: Long-running processes spawned by the runner and reaped at teardown. Top-level daemons declare a phase (pre_setup or post_setup). See SPEC.md §6.5.

steps.description: Test steps; assertion failures are reported per step.

cleanup.description: Post-condition assertions. Temp HOME removal is handled by the test driver.

timeout.description: Go duration string (e.g. "30s", "2m"). On background:true steps this is the readiness start timeout.

capture.description: Map of variable name to capture expression. Expression is a JSONPath ('$.path') or 'regex:(pattern)'. Forbidden when background:true.

assert.description: Step assertions. Forbidden when background:true (stdout is not captured at point-of-use).

background.description: When true, the command is started as a daemon and the step succeeds as soon as ready passes. Forbids assert/capture; allows ready/stop/log_assert. See SPEC.md §6.5.

log_assert.description: Assertions evaluated at teardown against the daemon's captured stdout+stderr. Only valid when background:true.

phase.description: When to start: pre_setup runs before setup steps; post_setup (default) runs after.

start_timeout.description: Go duration. Total time allowed to reach ready. Default 10s.

capture.description: One-shot capture run against the daemon's stdout+stderr log once ready, exposing values as {{ var }} to later steps.

log_assert.description: Assertions evaluated at teardown against the daemon's captured stdout+stderr.

ready_check.description: Gates daemon startup. Exactly one of tcp / log_contains / command / pid_file may be set; empty means 'started == ready'.

tcp.description: host:port to poll with net.Dial; ready when a TCP connection succeeds.

log_contains.description: Substring to search for in the captured stdout+stderr.

command.description: Probe command; ready when it exits 0.

pid_file.description: Path that must exist and be non-empty.

stop_spec.description: Teardown semantics. Defaults: signal=TERM, grace=5s, expected_exit=0. After grace, SIGKILL is sent and the spec fails.

type.description: Built-in: exit_code, contains, not_contains, stderr_contains, regex, json_path, count, golden_file. Custom types must use the 'x-' prefix and be registered in Config.Assertions.
